### Fixed
- **A stdio MCPServer's tool calls run under its `spec.timeout`.** The client factory applied the server's timeout to the streamable-http and SSE clients only, so every request to a stdio server, a tool call above all, was cut at the 30 s default whatever its `spec.timeout` said: a bridge waiting on a remote tool, or a local server doing a slow read, failed with a deadline its definition allowed it to outlast. The factory now sets the budget once for every transport it builds, so a stdio server with `spec.timeout: 60` completes a 45 s tool call and one that outlasts it fails with `no answer within the server's timeout of 1m0s`. The field's documentation in the CRD says it bounds every operation of every server type. ([#1297](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1297))
